blurb: Guests can visit the tasting room in Phoenixville to sample 6-8 rotating kombucha flavors on tap and bring their own growler to fill. The venue also offers 5-gallon kegs, 12 oz bottles, merchandise, and culinary delights. The tasting room is open every Saturday from 10 am to 3 pm and hosts special events for groups up to 25 people.
